meanings: to promote, to enhance, to further, to advance (a cause etc)
to appreciate (financially), to increase in value, value-added (accountancy)

to prick, to run or stick (a needle etc) into, mug or jug used for serving beer (loanword from "jar"), used in 挣扎, variant of 扎, to tie, to bind, classifier for flowers, banknotes etc: bundle, Taiwan pr. [zhá], (of troops) to be stationed (at)
strong, solid, sturdy, firm, practical, variant of 扎实
to deep fry, Taiwan pr. [zhà], to burst, to explode, to blow up, (fig.) to fly into a rage
